title: Sales Support Administrator
description:
Job Title: Sales Support Administrator

Start Date: 28th September 2026

End Date: 29th January 2027

Hourly rate: 15.54 per hour

Working Days and Hours: Monday - Friday, between 8.30am to 5.30pm, totalling 37 hours each week

Location: Reading - fully office based and once trained hybrid working could then be introduced

We are looking for a highly organised Sales Support Administrator to come and join our clients team on a temporary basis. You will be supporting the sales team in a varied and busy environment checking and uploading multiple documents and contracts onto our client system.

We are looking for a candidate who is extremely organised, has high attention to detail and self-motivated. Strong and confident IT skills specifically working on Microsoft Word and Excel is essential.

Responsibilities include however, are not limited to:
- Accurately log and quote contracts
- Process and maintain a high volume of information and customer requirements
- Ensure all work is accurately logged and meeting all compliance guidelines
- Liaise with internal and external customers regarding their contracts
- Support the team with pricing, retention and renewal contract related admin
- Resolving queries and issues
- Assisting other teams and additional administrative tasks when required

To be successful the individual must have strong communication skills, a confident multi-tasker and someone who thrives within a busy team. You will be joining a growing department who have targets and tight deadlines to meet therefore you must be able to manage your own workload each day.

Previous experience working in a similar role would be ideal however not essential as full training will be provided.

Due to a very structured training plan, we cannot consider anyone who has holiday in the first 4-6 weeks of the assignment

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Investment Management Administrator
description:
Investment Management Administrator

Location: Cardiff

Salary: Up to £28,000

Working Pattern: Hybrid, with 2 days working from home

Contract: Permanent, Full-time

About the Role

We are currently recruiting for a Team Administrator to join a leading UK wealth management business in its Cardiff office. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and client-focused individual to join a high-performing team and provide essential administrative support to Investment Managers, Portfolio Managers, clients, introducers and internal teams.

You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of the team, maintaining accurate records, managing client requests and supporting the onboarding and ongoing servicing of clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Open, scan and save post to client files.
- Respond to client and introducer queries by telephone and email.
- Manage workflow queues and ensure requests are dealt with promptly.
- Arrange meetings for Investment Manager teams.
- Liaise with relevant internal teams to support the effective onboarding of new clients.
- Initiate incoming and outgoing transfers and keep Investment Managers and Portfolio Managers updated on progress.
- Instruct internal cash and stock transfers between portfolios.
- Process client payment instructions, including arranging call-backs where required.
- Complete client KYC and account amendments.
- Process ISA, LISA, JISA and Flexible ISA subscriptions.
- Assist with meeting preparation, including printing and binding client and introducer reports and presentations.
- Build strong relationships with introducers, paraplanning teams and clients.
- Ensure all activities are carried out in line with FCA Conduct Rules and internal procedures.
- Provide wider administrative support to the team as required.

About You

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and confident communicating with a range of stakeholders.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a similar administrative role, preferably within wealth management or investment management.
- A genuine interest in and understanding of financial services.
- Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- The ability to build effective relationships with clients, professional advisers, Investment Managers, product providers and internal stakeholders.
- A proactive and positive approach, with a genuine passion for delivering excellent outcomes.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively as part of a team.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £28,000.
- Hybrid working with 2 days from home.
- The opportunity to join an established and highly regarded wealth management business.
- A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
- Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression.
- The chance to work alongside experienced Investment Managers and wealth management professionals.

If you are an organised administrator with an interest in financial services and are looking for your next career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: Due to a high volume of applications, if your CV does not reflect the essential requirements, or you answer 'no' to key screening questions, we may not be able to contact you.

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Transport Service Coordinator

Salary: £29,705.20 per annum, plus 15% annual employee bonus scheme, 3% annual salary review & Veolia benefits

Hours: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

Location: Cardiff, CF15 7 QT

When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone.
With one of the largest growing fleets in the UK, our drivers are pivotal to delivering essential services. They work hard to serve their local communities and make a positive impact every day. Whether you're looking to overhaul the industry, or just do a good day's work, we know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.

What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Stream - Employee financial well being support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential

What you'll be doing;
- Day-to-day management of service delivery, including the dynamic allocation of work to vehicles/routes
- Communicating with customers and stakeholders, providing status updates and maintaining contact with drivers
- Completing debriefs with front line staff and reporting necessary actions or updates as required
- Face-to-face engagement with drivers, supporting them to address any issues on route
- Reporting of all safety concerns or container damage and encouraging 'stop the job' if it is deemed unsafe to continue
- Ensuring Veolia legal compliance on-site (WTD, O'licence and transport compliance)

What we're looking for;

Essential:
- Able to demonstrate an understanding of transport compliance and WTD
- Good communication skills communicating with people of all levels including drivers, frontline employees and customers
- Ability to organise a busy workload and operate at a fast pace Working with a quality management system e.g. ISO Managing transport compliance. Experienced IT Skills, and the ability to adapt to Google operating systems

Desirable:
- Previous experience operating within a similar industry; waste/transport/logistics

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Part-time role - 20.0 Hours per week

Part-time shift pattern:

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday

4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM 4:45 PM - 9 PM OFF OFF

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 pro-rata which goes up to £26,738 pro-rata after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Cardiff, you'll support the smooth running of the accounting and finance operations for a retail business. Your role will involve managing financial transactions, ensuring accuracy, and assisting in essential reporting tasks.

Client Details

Our client is a highly successful and customer-focused business operating within the automotive sector, recognised for delivering premium products and exceptional service standards. With a strong reputation, continued growth, and a commitment to employee development, they offer a professional and supportive working environment where individuals are encouraged to develop their skills and build long-term careers. The business prides itself on teamwork, excellence, and maintaining the highest standards across all areas of its operations.

Description

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join a busy and successful finance team within a well-established automotive retail business in Cardiff.

This role will have a strong emphasis on the Purchase Ledger function and will suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received notes
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Managing supplier queries via telephone and email
- Preparing payment runs in line with business deadlines
- Maintaining accurate supplier account records
- Assisting with month-end processes and ledger reconciliations
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc accounting duties
- Ensuring compliance with internal financial controls and procedures
- Building strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- Experience in accounting or finance roles within a similar environment.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- A keen eye for detail and accuracy in financial tasks.
- A basic understanding of financial regulations and reporting standards.

Job Offer
- A salary of 27,000
- A permanent role within the retail industry in Cardiff.
- Opportunities to develop your skills in a professional finance setting.
- Great entry level opportunity

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Administrator

title: Receptionist
description: Four Elms Medical Centres are looking for two part time medical receptionists to join our busy, friendly practice team. The applicant must be enthusiastic and caring. We are seeking highly motivated, hardworking individuals with excellent communication skills, who are able to work within a team but also under their own initiative. The hours may be flexible but will range from 8.00 - 6.30 Monday to Friday. Each role is for 18 hours per week split into 3 x 6 hour shifts. The main duties of the post will be dealing with patients in a polite and confident manner, answering the telephones, issuing prescriptions, liaising with clinicians and team members, and some adminstistration work. This role will require a sensitive, empathetic manner. Welcoming patients and visitors, in person or on the telephone. Answering and/or referring enquiries appropriately. Maintaining confidentiality of personal information. Assisting in maintaining the smooth running of the reception office by carrying out general administrative and reception tasks. Contribute to the team effort by working effectively as a valued team member.

title: Admin/Receptionist
description: Care Navigator Butetown Medical Practice We are a friendly, fun and supportive mixed-age team at Butetown Medical Practice, and we are looking for two enthusiastic people to join us as Care Navigators. As a Care Navigator, you will be the first point of contact for patients, helping them access the right services and support for their individual needs. You will work closely with GPs, nurses, administrative staff and other members of the practice team to ensure patients receive the appropriate care and guidance. Supporting patients to access the most appropriate health, wellbeing and community services. Listening to patients and understanding their individual needs. Providing information and signposting to relevant services and organisations. Working closely with the wider practice team and external services. Maintaining accurate and confidential patient records. Helping patients navigate the NHS and local community support available to them. We are looking for people who are friendly, approachable, organised and compassionate, with excellent communication skills and a genuine desire to make a difference to our patients. If you enjoy working as part of a team and would like to be part of a welcoming and supportive practice, we would love to hear from you. Main Duties Meeting and greeting patients in a friendly, welcoming and professional manner. Booking, cancelling and rearranging patient appointments. Dealing with patient enquiries in person, by telephone and via email. Answering telephone calls and directing patients to the appropriate service or member of the team. Managing incoming and outgoing emails and responding to queries appropriately. Scanning and uploading patient correspondence and documents onto the clinical system. Coding patient information and ensuring records are kept accurate and up to date. Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times. Working closely with the wider practice team to ensure patients receive a high-quality and efficient service. Providing general administrative and reception support as required. We are looking for two friendly, approachable and enthusiastic Care Navigators to join our fun, supportive mixed-age team at Butetown Medical Practice . The role involves meeting and greeting patients, booking appointments, dealing with patient enquiries, answering telephone calls and emails, and providing general reception and administrative support. Duties will also include scanning, coding and maintaining accurate patient records. We are looking for someone who is organised, reliable, caring and has excellent communication skills , with a positive attitude and a commitment to providing a welcoming service to our patients.
